title: 第29章 绝境！
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
天牢后山，乱葬岗。

    浓郁的灰色煞气如沸水般翻滚。

    陈然手提黑铁长刀，正欲转身离开。

    四周的温度骤然降至冰点。

    地面上散落的枯骨开始微微颤动，发出令人牙酸的摩擦声。

    灰雾深处，一阵凄厉的哀嚎声撕裂寂静。

    无数游离的阴魂煞气受到某种气机牵引，疯狂向着半空中汇聚。

    眨眼间，一头高丈许、青面獠牙的怨灵凝聚成形。

    怨灵四周环绕着肉眼可见的冰冷阴风，身躯由实质般的煞气构成，空洞的眼窝里闪烁着幽绿色的鬼火。

    它发出刺耳的尖啸，张开生满利齿的大口，裹挟着漫天飞舞的碎骨，猛地扑向下方的陈然。

    劲风扑面，吹得陈然的衣角猎猎作响。

    陈然停下脚步，缓缓抬起眼皮。

    “聒噪。”

    他没有拔刀。

    甚至连姿势都没有变。

    只是握着刀鞘的右手手腕微微一转。

    体内六品内息境的磅礴真气轰然爆发。

    连同刀鞘在内，黑铁长刀化作一道模糊的黑影，带着碾碎一切的狂暴力量，由下至上斜劈而出。

    空气中传出一声刺耳的爆鸣。

    刀罡如同一道黑色的闪电，瞬间撕裂了前方的空间。

    怨灵的尖啸声戛然而止。

    巨大的煞气身躯在半空中僵住，随后从中间裂开一条笔直的细线。

    “砰！”

    怨灵连惨叫都没来得及发出，便如同脆弱的瓷器般轰然炸碎，化作漫天随风消散的灰烬。

    陈然神色平静，仿佛只是随手掸去衣袖上的灰尘。

    他将长刀重新挂回腰间，踩着满地碎骨，大步隐入浓雾之中。

    ……

    京城，六扇门内堂。

    林琬一袭黑色劲装，双手撑在桌案边缘。

    桌上铺着一张详细的京城及周边地形图。

    一名身穿青衣的捕快快步走入堂内，单膝跪地。

    “头儿，查清楚了。”

    “张玉龙吐出的接头地点，在城西三十里外的废弃山庄。那里曾是前朝贪官私宅，荒废多年，地形隐蔽。”

    林琬目光如炬，手指重重地点在地图上的山庄位置。

    “官银案的核心账册，必定藏在那里。”

    青衣捕快面露难色。

    “今晚是灯火节，城内治安压力极大，衙门人手几乎全被抽调。我们要不要上报镇魔司请求增援？”

    林琬眼神一冷，直起身子。

    “不能上报。”

    “张玉龙招供的消息已被我封锁，高层中必然有对方的眼线。”

    “若是走漏风声，账册早就被转移了。”

    她拔出腰间佩刀，刀锋在烛光下闪烁寒芒。

    “今夜灯火节，全城注意力都在街头，正是他们防备最松懈、最急于转移账册的时候。”
content_en:
On the mountain behind Tianlao, there are mass graves.

    The thick gray evil spirit rolled like boiling water.

    Chen Ran was holding a long black iron knife and was about to turn around and leave.

    The surrounding temperature suddenly dropped to freezing point.

    The dead bones scattered on the ground began to tremble slightly, making a tooth-piercing friction sound.

    Deep in the gray fog, a shrill wail tore through the silence.

    Countless wandering ghosts and evil spirits were attracted by some kind of energy and gathered crazily in mid-air.

    In the blink of an eye, a vengeful spirit about ten feet tall with a green face and fangs condensed into shape.

    The resentful spirit is surrounded by an icy cold wind that is visible to the naked eye. Its body is composed of substantial evil spirit, and its empty eye sockets are flashing with green will-o'-the-wisps.

    It let out a piercing scream, opened its mouth full of sharp teeth, wrapped up the broken bones flying in the sky, and pounced towards Chen Ran below.

    A strong wind blew against his face, making the corners of Chen Ran's clothes rustle.

    Chen Ran stopped and slowly raised his eyelids.

    "Noisy."

    He didn't draw the knife.

    Not even the posture changed.

    He just turned his right wrist holding the scabbard slightly.

    The majestic true energy of the sixth-grade inner breath realm in his body suddenly exploded.

    Along with the scabbard, the long black iron sword turned into a blurry black shadow, slashing diagonally from bottom to top with the violent force of crushing everything.

    A piercing explosion filled the air.

    Dao Gang was like a black lightning, instantly tearing apart the space in front of him.

    The screams of the resentful spirits stopped abruptly.

    The huge evil body froze in mid-air, and then a straight thin line split from the middle.

    "Bang!"

    The resentful spirit didn't even have time to scream, before it exploded like fragile porcelain and turned into ashes that dispersed in the wind.

    Chen Ran looked calm, as if he was just dusting off the dust on his sleeves.

    He hung the long knife back on his waist, stepped on the broken bones on the ground, and strode into the thick fog.

    …

    In the capital city, there is a six-door inner hall.

    Lin Wan was dressed in black and had his hands on the edge of the table.

    Spread on the table is a detailed topographic map of the capital and surrounding areas.

    A policeman in green clothes quickly walked into the hall and knelt on one knee.

    "Boss, we checked it out."

    "The meeting place Zhang Yulong vomited was in an abandoned villa thirty miles west of the city. It was once the private residence of a corrupt official in the previous dynasty. It had been abandoned for many years and the terrain was hidden."

    Lin Wan's eyes were as bright as a flash, and he placed his fingers heavily on the location of the villa on the map.

    "The core account books of the official bank case must be hidden there."

    The Tsing Yi policeman looked troubled.

    "Tonight is the Festival of Lights, and the city's security is under great pressure. Almost all the Yamen's manpower has been redeployed. Should we report it to the Demon Suppression Division for reinforcements?"

    Lin Wan's eyes turned cold and he straightened up.

    "Cannot report."

    "The news of Zhang Yulong's confession has been blocked by me. There must be spies from the other party among the senior officials."

    "If the news had leaked out, the account books would have been transferred long ago."

    She pulled out the knife from her waist, and the blade shone coldly in the candlelight.

    "Tonight, during the Festival of Lights, the whole city's attention is on the streets. This is when they are most lax on their defenses and most eager to move their accounts."
